purpose: Bounded read-only substrate; no UI or model-generated adjudication.

filters.refs: Optional exact package refs; intersect registered scope
filters.after_id: Optional last returned stable ID; lexicographic pagination

input_contract.reject: Unknown query IDs, fields/operators, executable code, arbitrary traversal and out-of-range limits.

execution_rules: Select the registered IDs or exact family values; apply filters by intersection; join refs to VER-<ref>. Never infer approved status from recency.
Sort by stable finding/assumption/baseline ID, then observation ID; paginate after sorting. Count unique records by ID; comparison and QA ledgers have separate denominators.
Traverse only listed edge types and named joins, at most three hops. Return null with an unknown reason for absent fields. A missing edge is not evidence of absence.

Only calculate paired differences/ratios where an existing adjudication authorizes the named component and units, period, statistic and denominator match. No pooling across versions or overlapping representations.
Return existing classifications unchanged. NOT_COMPARABLE and UNRESOLVED results are explanatory evidence, not numeric ratios.

Read manifest-listed shards only. Join full canonical adjudication/challenge ledgers by finding_id where graph projection omits detailed evidence. SOURCE.data.review_status is historical retrieval metadata; canonical reviewed ledgers govern review status.
provenance_contract: Return source_id, document_id, locator, original, extraction_method, transformation, status from each selected record and traversed supporting edge.
Resolve source_id to SOURCE.data.url for Mission 3; for Mission 1 use data/sources.jsonl joined on source_id. Retain raw/text hashes where present.
Return version record URL, source download URL, archived locator, and canonical ledger path/record ID; no invented page numbers.
Include classification rationale, limitations and adversarial-challenge result with each finding.
caveats: An empty result means no reviewed match within frozen query scope, not no such assumption in TSA.
Discovery indexes are excluded from reviewed results; they may only be used in a separately labeled future discovery mode.
Lineage is not numerical baseline verification; serial versions and transfers are not independent replications.
